what_it_does: Protects travellers against medical and journey-related risks during domestic or international trips.
coverage: Emergency medical evacuation to nearest suitable facility or home country (as per policy terms)
Trip cancellation or interruption due to covered reasons
Loss or delay of checked-in baggage
Personal accident cover in some variants
key_points: Region-specific sum insured and sub-limits; benefits often defined in USD for international trips
Pre-existing illnesses usually excluded or covered only under specific add-ons/conditions
High-risk activities (adventure sports, etc.) often excluded unless add-on is taken
Maximum trip duration limits vary by plan (e.g., 30/60/90 days etc.)
Cashless assistance through global assistance partners and 24x7 helpline

what_it_does: Multi-level travel insurance providing medical and non-medical protection during trips.
coverage: Hospitalization due to illness or accident
Dental treatment due to accidental injury
best_for: Travellers who want to choose coverage level based on budget and destination
People who prefer multiple plan tiers (Standard to Platinum) for flexibility
key_checks_before_buying: Whether pre-existing conditions are covered, partially covered, or excluded
Per-day and per-incident limits for medical and baggage claims
Coverage for adventure sports or high-risk activities, if required
Country-specific exclusions or restrictions (e.g., certain war-risk regions)

what_it_does: Overseas travel insurance providing protection against medical emergencies and trip-related risks.
coverage: Cashless medical facilities through global networks
Trip cancellation or interruption for covered reasons
Compensation for flight or travel delays
Personal accident cover in many variants
insurer_quality_notes: Tata AIG is widely used for international travel insurance
Competitive claim settlement experience in travel segment as per public reviews
Strong assistance tie-ups for international claims and medical support
key_checks_before_buying: Exact medical sum insured and sub-limits for OPD, IPD, and evacuation
Coverage for pre-existing diseases (often limited or excluded)
Requirements for documentation and approvals for cashless treatment
Geographical coverage (Schengen, worldwide excluding USA/Canada, etc.)
